text_blocks.snippet: The fastest way to recover from COVID-19 symptoms depends on the severity of the illness. For mild cases, rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage symptoms. For those at higher risk, early treatment with medications like Paxlovid is crucial and must be started within 5-7 days of symptom onset to be effective, according to the CDC.

text_blocks.snippet: The "best" COVID-19 treatment depends on individual factors like age, health status, and the time since symptom onset. For those at high risk of severe illness, antiviral medications like Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir with ritonavir) and remdesivir (Veklury) are often recommended, especially when started early in the course of the illness. Molnupiravir (Lagevrio) is another oral antiviral option, primarily for adults. It's crucial to consult with a doctor to determine the most appropriate treatment plan.
